consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

facts.title: corrective action following accident investigation at TK-7101

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had degraded below its design intent, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on TK-7101, PSV-7101 and TK-7104 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically transferring hydrocarbon between vessels. TK-7101 (product storage tanks) is in service for export product storage. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had degraded below its design intent. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 21 December 2006 a corrective action on TK-7101, PSV-7101 and TK-7104 at Cape Verity Export Terminal was reviewed against the key safeguard it was raised to restore.
